subject: Petri dev seeds vs PLAN I18: real organisations with invented wrongdoing
body: Found while planning realism rewrites (experiments/taste_petri/ideas/realism.md): 10 of the 12 dev seeds in data/petri/seeds_v2.jsonl name a real organisation and several attach invented wrongdoing to it (e.g. seed_116 fabricates an acquisition involving a listed company). These are upstream Petri 2.0 seeds, so stock arms keep them as-is, but loop rewrites should swap in fictional actors per I18. Flagging for the seed owner; nothing edited.
